title: Alibaba launches $10 billion Hong Kong share placement to fund AI spending
summary: Alibaba announced plans to sell 710 million ordinary shares at HK$112.70 each (3.6% discount), raising net proceeds of ~HK$79.7 billion (~USD 10.2B). All net proceeds will be invested in full-stack AI capabilities including chips, infrastructure, and AI model development. The deal is expected to close August 26 and would be the largest-ever primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed company.
why: 重大稀释事件（3.6%折让）：短期或压制9988.HK/BABA股价，关注sell put卖方行权风险；另一面，管理层全力押注AI基础设施体现高确信度，可能驱动长期估值重估。对港股科技板块有示范效应，隐含波动率短期可能上升。

title: Nvidia reports Q2 FY2027 earnings on Aug. 26 — company guided ~$91B revenue; analysts expect ~$93-95B, ~96% YoY growth
summary: Nvidia is set to report second-quarter FY2027 results on August 26. The company previously guided revenue of $91B ±2%, while Wall Street consensus sits at approximately $93-95B, implying ~96% year-over-year growth driven by Blackwell GPU demand. Stock has gained ~17.7% YTD and sits near $219. Analysts broadly rate as Buy with average target ~$302.
why: 本周三英伟达财报是全球AI景气度晴雨表：若营收超过$93B且毛利率维持75%以上，对AI硬件、云计算及HBM存储（SK海力士/美光）均为强正面信号；Sell put策略者注意财报前后隐含波动率将走高，财报落地后IV Crush风险。

title: Gold remains strong near $4,600 as US national debt hits $40 trillion record
summary: Spot gold climbed to a multi-month high near $4,600/oz on August 21-22, with US futures briefly touching higher levels. The rally is driven by a sharp USD decline following US Treasury plans to expand longer-dated bond purchases, record national debt hitting $40 trillion, and record central bank buying (288.9 tonnes in Q2 2026, +62% YoY). Fed rate-hike probability for September meeting sits at ~31%.
why: 黄金走强是避险情绪信号：美国债务风险升温+美元走弱组合，有利于黄金/大宗商品持仓。对老铺黄金（6181.HK）长期基本面利好；同时暗示市场对美联储9月鹰派预期有所摇摆，需关注Jackson Hole（8/28）Warsh讲话对美元及利率路径的影响。

title: China keeps 1-year LPR at 3.00% and 5-year LPR at 3.50% for 15th consecutive month
summary: The People's Bank of China held both benchmark lending rates unchanged on August 20: the one-year LPR at 3.00% and the five-year LPR at 3.50%. This marks the 15th consecutive month of no change since June 2025, signaling policy stability as authorities balance economic support with financial risk management amid persistent deflationary pressures.
why: LPR连续15个月不变，按揭成本稳定，对消费/地产板块短期无催化。但维持宽松基调有利港股/A股整体流动性预期；对持有消费股（海底捞、蜜雪冰城）的Sell put策略，支撑'利率环境不恶化'的前提。

title: Temu-owner PDD Holdings reports Q2 2026 earnings: profit beat but revenue misses on elevated Temu marketing costs
summary: PDD Holdings reported Q2 2026 results on August 24, beating profit expectations while revenue fell short of analyst estimates (~$17B expected), reflecting high Temu promotional and shipping costs globally. Management acknowledged an uncertain short-term outlook as Temu continues aggressive global expansion investment. Conference call held at 7:30 AM ET.
why: 业绩分化：利润超预期但营收未达预期，核心矛盾是Temu烧钱换规模。对拼多多stock投资者，收益质量改善迹象尚需验证；营收miss可能打压市场对中国出海电商增速的预期，间接利空美团Keeta等出海扩张逻辑。Sell put的话需关注财报后波动率。
